root_cause: The sip gloss token is attached to the beverages align cell. |sip selects the color only. _under_x searches the previous Chinese line in the same cell; there is no sip key in the beverages cell, so it falls back to the beverages column center.
exact_fix: Move the gloss token to the sip Chinese align value.
Split to with empty Chinese from **sip** so the English focus and Chinese focus share a column center.
Add the existing {{一行}} marker to the first align English token and c.en to retain the current visible line grouping.
Keep c.zh equal to concatenated align Chinese values.

layout.automatic_font_change_reason: The whole explanatory phrase now determines the width of the sip align cell; official renderer fits the one-line chunk by reducing the S1 font size.

preserved: English spoken/displayed words, Chinese body wording, sentence/chunk boundaries, and sip-only color mapping. No audio data was changed or regenerated.
integration_notes: Legacy-recap edits touch the final sentence, while this overlay touches only S1, S11, S12.
New focus words use existing pre-25 sequential coloring; adding them can rotate colors of later existing focus words. The sip-only fix preserves every color.
The old generator informational article comparator removes bold only, so it prints a literal difference for the supported {{一行}} marker. Official display/audio strip it.
